headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5.5 with expanded capabilities
body: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5, generating significant developer attention across technical communities. The model shows improvements in reasoning and performance metrics that warrant evaluation for clinical decision support and documentation tasks. Healthcare organizations currently assessing large language models for EHR integration, clinical coding, or diagnostic assistance should benchmark this release against existing deployments. The demonstrated autonomous capabilities in contract handling and biomolecular modeling suggest potential applications in prior authorization workflows and research document processing. Vendors integrating Claude into healthcare platforms will need to reassess cost-performance tradeoffs and clinical validation requirements.
